purpose: Prove the first playable minute can be understood without dev panels by using only the Guide prompt, minimal playtest HUD, target/readability cues, camera, and tissue-shift status strip.

visibleWhenDebugHidden.tertiary: MorphReadabilitySystem as tiny no-gate status strip
visibleWhenDebugHidden.targeting: reticle, target line, and player-core halo/glint

hudRules.rule: No critical first-minute instruction may only appear in debug overlay text.
Guide prompt remains the main world-facing instruction.
Playtest HUD shows only objective, action hint, target, controls, and slice state.
Full and compact debug remain available through F1/F2 or Back cycle.
This pass cannot add cells, morphs, gates, route runtime, dialogue trees, quest logs, combat, doors, teleports, or old chamber runtime.

statusReadouts.opening: First Minute: learn seed, scar, pulse, and chorus.

minimalControls.line: Left Stick move · Right Stick camera · RT absorb · X pulse · R3 recenter · Back debug
WASD move · IJKL camera · F absorb · Space/X pulse · C recenter · F1/F2/F3 debug

acceptanceTests: Playtest HUD is visible when debug is hidden.
Guide prompt is visible and primary.
Tissue Shift is small secondary progress/status only.
F1/F2/F3 still reveal and hide debug panels.
Required first-minute chain can be completed without reading debug overlays.
No new cells, no new morphs, no gates, no old chamber runtime.
